Log in with your Telegram account.
The login stays on this phone.
Type your phone number.
Telegram will send you a code.
Telegram sent you a code.\nFind it in the Telegram app, in the chat “Telegram”.\nType it here:
Telegram sent you a code by SMS.\nType it here:
Your Telegram account has a password.\nType it here.

Logged in ✔

Now Telemedia gets its own Telegram key.
This takes about a minute.
Telegram will send a code to your “Telegram” chat.
You don't need to do anything with it.
Telemedia needs a key from Telegram.\nType your phone number.\nTelegram will send a code to your Telegram app.
Telegram sent you a code.\nFind it in the chat “Telegram”, in the message “Web login code”.\nType it here:
I already have an api_id and api_hash
Telemedia finds videos in your Telegram groups and channels.\nJoin some to get videos right away.\nYou can leave them anytime.
A Stremio web page will open.\nLog in there with the same Stremio account as on this phone.\nConfirm, then come back here.

Added to your Stremio account ✔
Now open Stremio on this phone.
Don't see Telemedia there?
Then Stremio on this phone uses another account.
Tap Add to Stremio again and log in with that account.
Waiting for you to confirm on the Stremio page…

Open Stremio.
Pick a movie or an episode.
Choose a Telemedia stream.

Telemedia runs in the background.
It starts by itself when the phone turns on.
Watch on a TV or computer

A TV or computer on the same Wi-Fi can play from this phone.
Tap Connect a user.
Log in to that user's Stremio account and confirm.
Or the user scans the code with their own phone.
Done with that user?
Find their account at the bottom.
Tap Remove from Stremio account under it.
User: scan this with your phone.\nThen confirm in your Stremio account.
Or type this address in that user\'s Stremio, under Add-ons:

Remove Telemedia from %1$s?
The phone gets a new key.
That user can't use it anymore.
Your other users get the new key by themselves.
Removed ✔\nThe old address doesn\'t work anymore.

Connected to %1$s ✔
That user's Stremio now shows Telemedia.
Keep the phone on this Wi-Fi while you watch.
Charging is best.

Smart TVs (Hisense, LG, Samsung) need a secure address.
It isn't ready yet.
Telemedia keeps trying.
Android TV and computers work now.
This router blocks the secure address.\nSo smart TVs (Hisense, LG, Samsung) can\'t use it here.\nAndroid TV and computers work.
Connect the phone to Wi-Fi to watch on a TV.
Stremio disconnected an account marked ⚠.\nTap Connect another user and log in to it again.\nOr tap Remove from Stremio account under it.
Let Telemedia run in the background.\nThen videos don\'t stop while you watch.

Stop Telemedia?
Stremio on this phone and on your TVs can't play from it.
It stays stopped, even after the phone restarts.
Tap Start Telemedia to turn it back on.
Nothing runs in the background.\nStremio on this phone and on your TVs can\'t play from it.\nTap Start Telemedia to turn it back on.
Log this phone out of Telegram?\nTelemedia also leaves the connected Stremio accounts.\nSo the next person who logs in doesn\'t get them.
Sends your Telegram videos to Stremio
